subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should OpenClaw implement first-class active WebChat run adoption across UI WebSocket reconnects, or declare the current Stop visibility, send retry, and history refresh behavior sufficient?
rationale: Current main provides partial mitigations, while the only direct recovery PR is stale, conflicting, and proof-gated; choosing the permanent reconnect contract and whether to adopt or replace that PR needs maintainer direction.

options.title: Open a current-main replacement
options.body: Implement active-run recovery against the current ui/src/pages/chat and packages/gateway-protocol surfaces, preserving attribution to the open recovery PR where useful.

options.title: Revive the open recovery PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopter to rebase it onto current main, move protocol work to the live package, resolve blockers, and add live reconnect proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigations
options.body: Close only if maintainers explicitly decide that Stop visibility, queued-send retry, and history refresh satisfy the product contract without run-id adoption.

recommendation.title: Open a current-main replacement
recommendation.body: Implement active-run recovery against the current ui/src/pages/chat and packages/gateway-protocol surfaces, preserving attribution to the open recovery PR where useful.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns the current-main refactor surface most likely to carry a replacement or product contract decision.
